title: Cloudflare Workersを丸ごと守れる新Access機能が来たよ！
summary: Cloudflare Workers に Cloudflare Access を適用する新しい方法が発表されたよ。Worker 単体、またはアカウント全体をまとめて保護できるようになって、ドメインやプレビュー URL の変更にも自動で追従するようになったの。
title_en: You Can Now Protect Every Cloudflare Worker with Access at Once!
summary_en: Cloudflare announced new ways to apply Cloudflare Access to Workers, letting you protect a single Worker or every Worker in your account at once. The policy now follows the Worker itself, so it automatically covers any domains or preview URLs you add later.
og_title: Workers, Access - You can now enable Access on a Worker or all Workers at once
